articles.title: Only 1,000 $50 World Cup Tickets for 8 Million New Yorkers—Here’s How to Get One!
articles.summary: New York City’s mayor is selling 1,000 World Cup tickets for just $50—about the price of five lattes. A lottery on May 25 gives residents a shot at seats for MetLife Stadium games, except the $33,000 final.

articles.title: World Court Says: Yes, Workers Have the Right to Strike!
articles.summary: The International Court of Justice ruled that a 1948 labor treaty protects the right to strike, even though the word “strike” isn’t in it. Unions celebrated, but the U.S. hasn’t signed the treaty.

articles.title: Maine’s Senator Collins Bets on Bringing Home the Bacon to Win Reelection
articles.summary: Republican Sen. Susan Collins is using her power to send federal money to Maine—like funding for a breakwater dock in a tiny town—to convince voters she’s worth reelecting over Democrat Graham Platner.
